paras: 10 Days Jaipur-Bikaner-Jaisalmer-Jodhpur-Udaipur-Ajmer/Puskhar-Jaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR062
Rs.21399/- per person
Day 01 – Arrival in Jaipur

Known as the Pink City, Jaipur consists of grand palaces, vibrant bazaars, and a rich cultural heritage. Upon arrival at Jaipur Railway Station/Airport, our representative will greet you and accompany you to your hotel. After settling in, in the evening, explore the modern attractions of the Pink City:
Statue Circle: Modern landmark in Jaipur.
Birla Auditorium & Planetarium: Cultural and educational hub.
Vidhan Sabha: Legislative Assembly building.
Birla Mandir: White marble Hindu temple.
Jawahar Kala Kendra: Cultural center showcasing art.
Enjoy a delightful Rajasthani dinner at a resort with folk music and cultural dances in a rural village setting.
Overnight stay in Jaipur.
Day 02 – Jaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, embark on a tour of Jaipur's historic sites in the old Pink City:
Hawa Mahal: Palace of Winds.
City Palace: Royal residence with museums.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar: Astronomical instruments.
Jal Mahal: Water palace amidst Man Sagar Lake.
Amer Fort: Ancient hilltop fortress.
Nahargarh Fort & Places: Scenic fort offering city views.
In the evening, witness the mesmerizing Light & Sound show at Amer Fort.
Overnight stay in Jaipur.

Day 03 – Jaipur to Bikaner Nestled in the desert, Bikaner is famous for its imposing forts, camel safaris, and Karni Mata Temple. After breakfast, check out from the hotel and proceed to Bikaner. Known for its desert surroundings, upon arrival, visit:
Junagarh Fort: Impressive fort with palaces.
Camel Breeding Farm: Center for research on camels.
Karni Mata Temple: Temple famous for its rats.
Overnight stay in Bikaner.
Day 04 – Bikaner to Jaisalmer

Jaisalmer, the Golden City shines with its complexly carved sandstone architecture, desert landscapes, and vibrant culture. After breakfast, drive to Jaisalmer and check into the hotel. After freshening up, explore the Golden City:
War Museum: Exhibits military history.
Gadisar Lake: Scenic man-made lake.
Vyas Chhatri: Memorials with skilled carvings.
Overnight stay in Jaisalmer.
Day 05 – Sightseeing & Jaisalmer Desert
After breakfast, explore the highlights of Jaisalmer:
Jaisalmer Fort & Palaces: Iconic sandstone fort.
Jain Temples: Skilled carvings in temples.
Patwon ki Haveli: Historical mansions.
Salim Singh ki Haveli: Architectural marvel.
Nathmal ki Haveli: Fusion of local styles.
Experience a night in the desert with cultural programs, camel rides, bonfire, and dinner at a Desert Camp amidst sand dunes.
Overnight stay in Desert Camp.
Day 06 – Jaisalmer to Jodhpur Sightseeing
Dominated by the gigantic Mehrangarh Fort, Jodhpur is the Blue City, offering a mixture of history and busy markets. After breakfast at the Desert Camp, proceed to Jodhpur. Upon arrival, visit:
Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum: Grand palace showcasing history.
Jaswant Thada: Marble memorial.
Mehrangarh Fort: Majestic fort overlooking the city.
Clock Tower & Markets: Busy local markets.
Overnight stay in Jodhpur.
Day 07 – Jodhpur to Ranakpur to Udaipur

The City of Lakes captivates with its serene lakes, palaces like the City Palace, and romantic view. After breakfast, depart for Udaipur with a stop at Ranakpur Jain Temples, known for their skilled architecture. Upon reaching Udaipur, check in at the hotel.
Overnight stay in Udaipur.
Day 08 – Udaipur Sightseeing
After breakfast, explore the charming Lake City:
City Palace: Majestic palace complex.
Jagdish Temple: Architectural marvel.
Bhartiya Lok Kala Mandal: Museum of folk arts.
Pratap Smarak: Memorial to Maharana Pratap.
Shilp Gram: Rural arts and crafts complex.
Bagore ki Haveli: Historical mansion.
Saheliyon ki Bari: Beautiful garden.
Overnight stay in Udaipur.
Day 09 – Udaipur to Ajmer/Pushkar
Ajmer, A spiritual center renowned for the Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chishti, attracting pilgrims from all over.
Pushkar, Known for its sacred lake and the only Brahma Temple in India, Pushkar hosts the famous Pushkar Camel Fair annually.
After breakfast, proceed to Pushkar. Check in at the hotel and visit Ajmer & Pushkar:
Dargah of Khwaja Muin-ud-din Chisti at Ajmer: Sufi holy place.
Lord Brahma Temple at Pushkar: Only Brahma temple in India.
Overnight stay in Pushkar.
Day 10 – Jaipur Departure
After breakfast, it's time for departure. You will be dropped at Jaipur Railway Station/Airport. (The Tour Ends)
Package Inclusions:
* Daily breakfast
* Air-conditioned car for transportation throughout the journey
* Driver allowance, fuel, parking fees, and all applicable taxes

Nakki Lake: Picturesque Lake surrounded by hills.
Sunset Point: Scenic view of twilight.
Tod Rock: Rock formation with views.
Guru Shikhar: Highest peak in Rajasthan.
Achalgarh Mahadev: Ancient temple with scenic views.
Brahma Kumari Ashram: Spiritual retreat center and meditation.
Overnight stay at a hotel in Mount Abu.

Jaipur, The pink city of India, decorated with palaces, forts, bazaars, and a rich textile of history and culture.

Birla Auditorium & Planetarium: Cultural and educational hub.

Day 09 – Jaipur Sightseeing
Explore the well known Jaipur's historic sites:
Hawa Mahal: Palace of Winds visit.
City Palace: Royal residence with museums.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar: Astronomical instruments visit.
Jal Mahal: Water palace amidst Man Sagar Lake.
